scripts.dev:backend: bash -c 'ROOT=$(pwd); [ -d .venv ] || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt; PYTHONPATH=$ROOT .venv/bin/uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --reload-dir backend --reload-dir agents --reload-dir pipelines --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --log-level info'
scripts.dev:frontend: bash -c 'cd frontend && npm install --prefer-offline --silent && npm run dev'
scripts.install:all: bash -c 'python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm install'
